title: Lint rules for form files: tab order, accelerators, shortcuts, actions, hints
summary: Reports duplicate TabOrder, clashing Alt letters and shortcuts, a control with an Action and its own OnClick, and (off by default) database components on a form, default component names and hints that never show; ships a default for disallowed-dfm-property
intro: Read this to see what each form file check compares, which controls and containers it leaves alone, and how often it fired on real projects.
